description: Renders a spreadsheet sheet using a hybrid canvas surface with HTML editing and accessibility overlays.

parameters.name: ActiveCellChanged
parameters.description: When true the grid is displayed in read-only mode: cell editing, context menu, and editing-related callbacks are disabled.

parameters.name: CellValueCommitted
parameters.description: Called when the user Ctrl+clicks a hyperlink in a cell.

parameters.name: CellValuesCommittedBatch
parameters.description: Called when a cell value is committed after editing.

parameters.name: ColumnWidth
parameters.description: Default row height in pixels.

parameters.name: ExternalFormulaEditValue
parameters.description: The zoom factor applied to the grid geometry and fonts (1.0 = 100%).

parameters.name: ExternalFormulaOriginCellRef
parameters.description: Whether a formula-bar editing session is currently active even before the latest live value is mirrored into the grid.

parameters.name: ExternalFormulaSessionActive
parameters.description: The external formula editor value when reference-picking is driven by the formula bar instead of inline cell editing.

parameters.name: FilterButtonClicked
parameters.description: Called when a batch of cell values is committed from the JavaScript engine.

parameters.name: IsFormatPainterActive
parameters.description: Called when the user requests strikethrough toggle.

parameters.name: IsReadonly
parameters.description: The origin cell of an external formula-bar session, used as an additional guard against unintended pointer selection changes.

parameters.name: OnBoldToggleRequested
parameters.description: Called when the user requests redo.

parameters.name: OnCellEdit
parameters.description: Called when the user requests select all.

parameters.name: OnCellReferenceRequested
parameters.description: Called when a cell enters or exits edit mode.

parameters.name: OnClearAllRequested
parameters.description: Called when content should be cleared.

parameters.name: OnClearContentRequested
parameters.description: Called when formatting should be cleared.

parameters.name: OnClearFormattingRequested
parameters.description: Called when Format Painter is activated from context menu.

parameters.name: OnColumnResizeRequested
parameters.description: Called when formula point mode inserts a cell reference.

parameters.name: OnCopyRequested
parameters.description: Called when the user clicks the in-cell validation dropdown arrow (list type).

parameters.name: OnCutRequested
parameters.description: Called when the user requests a paste-special operation (Ctrl+Shift+V).

parameters.name: OnDeleteColumnRequested
parameters.description: Called when the user requests insert column.

parameters.name: OnDeleteRequested
parameters.description: Called when the user requests delete column.

parameters.name: OnDeleteRowRequested
parameters.description: Called when the user requests insert row.

parameters.name: OnFindRequested
parameters.description: Called when the zoom should reset to 100% (Ctrl+0).

parameters.name: OnFormatCellsRequested
parameters.description: Called when a row is resized.

parameters.name: OnFormatPainterActivateRequested
parameters.description: Called when hidden columns near the selection should be shown.

parameters.name: OnFormatPainterApply
parameters.description: Whether Format Painter mode is active.

parameters.name: OnFormatPainterCancel
parameters.description: Called when Format Painter applies to a cell.

parameters.name: OnHideColumnsRequested
parameters.description: Called when hidden rows near the selection should be shown.

parameters.name: OnHideRowsRequested
parameters.description: Called when Format Painter is cancelled.

parameters.name: OnHyperlinkClick
parameters.description: Called when the active cell changes.

parameters.name: OnInsertColumnRequested
parameters.description: Called when the user requests delete row.

parameters.name: OnInsertRowRequested
parameters.description: Called when the user requests a cut operation.

parameters.name: OnItalicToggleRequested
parameters.description: Called when the user requests bold toggle.

parameters.name: OnPasteRequested
parameters.description: Called when the user requests a copy operation.

parameters.name: OnPasteSpecialRequested
parameters.description: Called when the user requests a paste operation.

parameters.name: OnRedoRequested
parameters.description: Called when the user requests undo.

parameters.name: OnReplaceRequested
parameters.description: Called when the Find panel should open (Ctrl+F).

parameters.name: OnRowResizeRequested
parameters.description: Called when a column is resized.

parameters.name: OnSelectAllRequested
parameters.description: Called when the user requests underline toggle.

parameters.name: OnStrikeThroughToggleRequested
parameters.description: Called when the user requests the Format Cells dialog.

parameters.name: OnUnderlineToggleRequested
parameters.description: Called when the user requests italic toggle.

parameters.name: OnUndoRequested
parameters.description: Called when the user requests delete selection.

parameters.name: OnUnhideColumnsRequested
parameters.description: Called when selected columns should be hidden.

parameters.name: OnUnhideRowsRequested
parameters.description: Called when selected rows should be hidden.

parameters.name: OnZoomResetRequested
parameters.description: Called when the zoom should change by one step (+1 to zoom in, -1 to zoom out).

parameters.name: OnZoomStep
parameters.description: Called when content and formatting should be cleared.

parameters.name: RowHeight
parameters.description: The sheet to render.

parameters.name: ValidationDropButtonClicked
parameters.type: EventCallback<(int Row, int Col, double ClientX, double ClientY)>
parameters.description: Called when the user clicks the auto-filter dropdown button of a header cell.

parameters.name: Zoom
parameters.description: Default column width in pixels.
